evidence_mode_config.full_text_mode_block:
Full-text evidence mode:
- Each record includes complete `selected_full_text_sections` extracted from Docling markdown.
- Treat the title, abstract, and selected full-text sections as the provided record; do not use outside knowledge.
- Use the selected full-text sections when they clarify criteria.
- When full-text sections contradict or refine the abstract, prefer the more specific full-text section evidence and mention that section in `evidence_snippet`.
- Do not infer from the paper title alone when the selected full-text sections do not support the criterion.

records.title: Unify learns cellular evolution with universal multimodal embeddings
records.final_rationale: Unify combines scRNA-seq with language-model embeddings as auxiliary features for transfer learning and perturbation prediction. That is wrapper-style feature fusion rather than a generative text-bio model.
records.evidence_snippet: combining RNA expression with embeddings from protein language models and general-purpose language models; prediction of perturbation responses across species

records.title: scMIR: a vision-language foundation model for single-cell light microscopy image representation
records.final_rationale: scMIR is a vision-language foundation model with paired microscopy images and structured textual captions plus text-guided alignment. The generative mechanism is not explicit enough to resolve beyond unclear.
records.evidence_snippet: paired single-cell images and structured textual captions; text-guided cross-modal alignment; self-supervised image reconstruction

records.title: CellDuality: Unlocking Biological Reasoning in LLMs with Self-Supervised RLVR.
records.final_rationale: CellDuality fine-tunes an existing LLM with SFT and self-supervised RLVR over textual biological prompts and outputs. That fits an application wrapper rather than a new foundation model.
records.evidence_snippet: all inputs to the LLM are constructed as textual prompts; output is a textual response y, generated autoregressively according to the policy
